features: Lanes: a section above the fields of a road with its cross-section (the road before and after it included) and a table with a column per lane: turn, width, bus, bicycle, vehicles, lane change; add and remove lanes; one undo step per change
A Lanes lens: roads by how much of their lanes is mapped (values per lane, count only, nothing)
Turn restrictions, the traffic sign field and the way table, to compare the lanes of the ways along a street
German by default; leaves out the surface photos, parking and the drawing tools
